fusions.name: Unexpected Arrival
fusions.desc: Leaps onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away and comes down with your full weight, dealing 14 damage, biting it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaving it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hop and Drop
fusions.desc: Hops in place and comes down hard, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spring to Cover
fusions.desc: Raises a shell of iron that absorbs the next 16 damage and holds for 5 seconds, and your armour rises by 5% while it holds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 3 seconds after you use it. Enemies more than 3 tiles away lose track of you.

fusions.name: Heavy Landings
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover raises your physical damage by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
